input.quote: This Agreement is governed exclusively by Singapore law, and the courts of Singapore have exclusive jurisdiction.
input.rationale: Singapore law with exclusive Singapore jurisdiction is outside our accepted list (New York, Delaware, California, England and Wales) and directly conflicts with Section 28.2, which gives the New York County state and federal courts exclusive jurisdiction. We replaced 28.1 with New York governing law and left Sections 28.2 and 28.3 intact so venue and the escalation process are unchanged.

input.quote: Customer's change of control does not give Vendor a right to terminate, suspend, reprice, accelerate Fees, or reduce service.
input.rationale: Section 24 tracks our preferred position: Customer may assign freely to an Affiliate or an M&A successor on notice (24.1); Vendor needs our consent for assignment, delegation or change of control and may never assign to a competitor (24.2); residual assignments require mutual consent not unreasonably withheld (24.3); and Vendor gets no termination, suspension or repricing right on our change of control (24.4). Section 13.3 consistently allows transfer of licence rights with a permitted assignment. No redline needed.
